notes: ἐπιλαβόμενοι heads on 'hold' as the meaning-bearing element of the support-verb rendering 'laid hold'; the object is accusative, a case English writes no preposition for, so under rule 106's accusative arm the 'on' is the verb's own phrasal government and Σωσθένην keeps a bare name.

ἔμελεν keeps 'cared for' on the same reasoning, οὐδέν standing as the Greek clause's nominative subject; giving 'for' to οὐδέν remains defensible if the English preposition is read as realizing the construction's complement.
τῷ before Γαλλίωνι is unrepresented under rule 23, the dative being recast as the English subject with no determiner written.
